Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 1. Overview

Apogee Indigo is a cross-platform mobile application that gives retail brands a single, branded app for

customer loyalty, stored-value gift cards, and promotional offers — combined into one digital wallet

carried on the customer's phone.

The application gives customers a single, mobile-first way to create an account, load and manage a

stored-value balance, browse and redeem rebates and offers, locate participating stores, and carry

their loyalty and gift cards directly in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet — without a separate physical card.

The app was originally built on Xamarin.Forms and has since been migrated to .NET MAUI, moving the

mobile codebase onto Microsoft's current cross-platform framework while preserving the existing

backend services and business logic that power the program.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 2. Business Context

Retail and multi-location brands running loyalty and stored-value programs typically need to:

•
Give customers one place to check their loyalty and gift-card balances

•
Let customers reload a stored-value account and pay from it in-store

•
Deliver targeted rebates, promotions, and offers that drive repeat visits

•
Help customers discover participating store locations and available products

•
Make loyalty and gift cards available inside the phone's native wallet, not a separate physical card

•
Keep the mobile app reliable and current as device platforms evolve

Running these as separate systems — a point-of-sale loyalty database, a physical gift card program, a

standalone promotions engine — is fragmented and hard for customers to use. Apogee Indigo

consolidates account management, stored value, loyalty, and offers into a single branded mobile app,

backed by a shared services platform.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.1 Account Creation & Secure Login

•
New customers create an account and complete an age-verification step where required by the brand

•
Returning customers sign in with a password or biometric authentication (fingerprint or face)

•
Self-service password recovery and change-password flows

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.2 Loyalty & Gift Card Wallet

•
A unified home screen presents both the customer's loyalty balance and stored-value gift card
balance

•
Customers can view full transaction history for loyalty activity and gift card spend

•
Multiple gift cards can be added to and managed within a single account

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.3 Add Funds & Payment Methods

•
Customers can reload their stored-value balance using a saved card or bank (ACH) payment method

•
Saved payment methods can be added, viewed, and managed from a dedicated payments screen

•
Promo codes can be applied when adding funds

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.4 Rebates & Offers Marketplace

•
A searchable, filterable catalog of rebates and promotional offers from participating merchants

•
Customers can browse all available offers or a personalized selection of offers

•
Offer filters help customers quickly find the most relevant promotions

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.5 Store & Product Discovery

•
A store locator lists participating store locations, with detailed store information

•
A dedicated product catalog lets customers browse what's available at participating locations

Section: 7. Technology Stack > 8. Value Delivered

•
Gives customers a single, unified wallet for loyalty rewards and stored value, instead of separate
cards and logins

•
Increases redemption and repeat visits through a dedicated rebates and offers marketplace

•
Removes the need for a physical card by bringing loyalty and gift cards into Apple Wallet and Google
Wallet

•
Modernizes the mobile codebase through a Xamarin-to-MAUI migration, moving onto Microsoft's
actively supported .NET MAUI framework and improving long-term maintainability, while preserving
the existing backend services and business logic

•
Extends account flexibility with authorized users and balance transfers

•
Strengthens reliability and customer engagement through integrated crash reporting, analytics, and
targeted notifications
